ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\angle AOB=2\angle BOC$, and $OD$ is the bisector of $\angle AOC$. If $\angle AOB=60^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because \angle AOB=2\angle BOC$ and $\angle AOB=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BOC= \frac{1}{2}\angle AOB=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOC=\angle AOB+\angle BOC=90^\circ$,\\
$\because$ OD is the bisector of $\angle AOC$,\\
$\therefore \angle COD= \frac{1}{2}\angle AOC=45^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BOD=\angle COD-\angle BOC=45^\circ-30^\circ=\boxed{15^\circ}$.

Ray OA goes steeply upward, ray OD goes up and to the right, ray OB goes almost horizontally to the right, and ray OC goes down and to the right.
